# DigitalOcean adds Terra; Router and spend pauses carry preview labels


By OpenTools Team


Terra access is new; the dashboard and pause entries are older.


##


Access


[The November 3 entry](https://ideas.digitalocean.com/changelog) adds GPT‑6.1 Terra through Serverless Inference, Inference Router (Public Preview) and model synthesis, using the same account, API and invoice.


##


Billing context


[The October 29 entry](https://ideas.digitalocean.com/changelog) described daily Billing Insights spend by model, token type and model access key. The Serverless Inference dashboard was generally available; spend thresholds with optional automatic pause per model access key were public preview. For rollout planning, separate spend observation from dependence on a preview interruption control.


Original source‑based illustration by OpenTools Team, from[DigitalOcean’s changelog](https://ideas.digitalocean.com/changelog) . Entries dated November 3 and October 29, 2026; not a product screenshot or test.
